items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got hired on the spot thanks to John Patton... Him and I together on a subway, going up and down the stairs with this drum set.

ctx.x: Really? Miles had his guys wear uniforms?

Because Miles was in his French Italian tailored suits and they were wearing… … I don't think that lasted too long. Anyway, Birdland. I caught Birdland before it closed. I think it closed maybe the end of the year or the next year. I can't remember. But I go back up to Minton's and in the house happened to be the organist John Patton and John said to me, "Man, Have you got a set of drums?" and I said, "Yeah" and he said, "You got a set of drums man, you got a gig." I said "Oh really?" I got hired on the spot…
How long was the engagement with Patton?
